content.text:
You can't with this RTL package - the private L2 is hard-disabled in `ax46mpv_advanced` and its RTL is not even shipped.

What I found:

1. The knob does exist: `NDS_L2C_CACHE_SIZE_KB` is defined as "Private L2-Cache Size" (legal values 0/64/128/256/512) in `external/ax46mpv_advanced/config_tools/nds-softcore-config:6328`. Your cfg has it at `{0}`.

2. But two constraints clamp it back to 0 no matter what you write in the cfg:
   - `nds-softcore-config:10253` - the constraint body starts with an unconditional `set_opt_value NDS_L2C_CACHE_SIZE_KB 0`.
   - `nds-softcore-config:12301` (`NDS_LIMITED_CONFIG`) - sets it to 0 and disables the option entirely.

   The build (`cmake/VerilatorHelpers.cmake:80`) runs `nds-softcore-config --load <cfg> --generate`, and that batch flow executes all constraints (`init_dependency_check`) before writing `config.inc`. So editing the cfg to `set o(NDS_L2C_CACHE_SIZE_KB) {256}` would just be overwritten - the generated `build/Vax46mpv_fpga_l3/.../config.inc` will still say `NDS_L2C_CACHE_SIZE_KB 0`.

3. Even bypassing the tool would not help: no Verilog file in `external/ax46mpv_advanced/andes_ip/` references `NDS_L2C_CACHE_SIZE_KB`. The package only contains `kv_l2cm.v` / `kv_l2nc.v` (coherence-manager side), not the private L2 cache itself. This is a "limited config" delivery - the L2 RTL was stripped.

To actually get a private L2 you need a full (non-limited) AX46MPV RTL drop from Andes. #!/bin/bash

# VSim Workspace Build Script
# This script builds released vsim image tar file

set -e

# arguments to docker targets
DOCKER_TARGET="$1"
if [[ ! "$DOCKER_TARGET" =~ ^(dev|runtime|bin|debug)$ ]]; then
    echo "Error: Invalid argument '$1'"
    echo "Usage: $0 {dev|runtime|bin|debug}"
    echo "  dev     - Development environment"
    echo "  runtime - Runtime environment"
    echo "  bin     - Binary only"
    echo "  debug   - debug version"
    exit 1
fi

# Generate a version file
tag=$(git describe --tags --always)
echo "vsim version : " "$tag"

if [[ "$DOCKER_TARGET" == "bin" ]]; then
    podman build --build-arg VERSION="$tag" --output=type=local,dest=andescycle-bin-"$tag" .
else
    # build image using docker or podman, archive build results
    podman build --target "$DOCKER_TARGET" --build-arg VERSION="$tag" -t andescycle-"$DOCKER_TARGET":"$tag" .
    podman save localhost/andescycle-"$DOCKER_TARGET":"$tag" | gzip > andescycle-"$DOCKER_TARGET"-"$tag".tar.gz
fi


echo "✅ Build complete"
